description: A PHP script for exporting test plan data in XML format within the TestLink project. Handles different export types such as 'tree', '4results', and 'linkedItems', and manages user input, session data, and file download.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request arguments for export options, including export type, filename, and session-based test case set.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI data structure with test plan info, export filename, and user options for rendering the export interface.
